objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object such as a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation prefix for the document type used in the document name.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive 4-digit number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version identifier of the document, incremented upon revisions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow or lifecycle status of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiration date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The time period for which a document remains valid before requiring a validity check; default is 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The time period for which an archived document is retained before physical deletion; default is 10 years.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to relevant IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute specifying which companies the document applies to.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute specifying the scopes or areas where the document is valid.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original office format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, specifies in which clients the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing a document, created by users with author rights, without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, created when a document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the user (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used for assigning authorizations, read access, and distribution.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of User Groups and persons assigned to a document who are informed about releases, either by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process that guides tasks through defined steps such as creation, review, and release with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature used by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification category defining the level and kind of document within the document pyramid.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the document type in the document pyramid (1 through 4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The type abbreviation used in naming documents of this type.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A structural entity such as a department or location to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report providing filtered information about documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g., Status Report, Search for Documents, Status Report for Acknowledgement).

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view presenting relevant documents and information based on distribution group assignments.

attributes.name: role_specificity
attributes.description: The role for which the dashboard is designed (e.g., Reader, Author).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a user that they have taken note of a released document, triggered through distribution for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system in which documents can be visible or created locally.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication in the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when changes are made to content, attributes, or attachments.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal, and the completed proposal is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is confirmed and extended by the default period, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: A document is declared out of force, archived, and all rights except for the archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to users or user groups for a specific document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms that they have taken note of a released document via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is reviewed and released through a workflow-supported approval process.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users about workflow tasks, status changes, or distribution events.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: A document can have one or more controlled attachments that are released together with the main document.
A document can have supplementary additional information objects that are not subject to the release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within it.
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute.
A document can be created based on a defined template for its document type.
Each document is classified under a specific document type.
Each document has a distribution list of user groups and persons for notification and acknowledgement.
Documents can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to invalidate it.
A request for reactivation references the archived document to be reactivated.
In a multi-client system, a document specifies in which clients it is visible.
Users are assigned to user groups for authorization and role management.
Distribution lists contain assigned user groups for notification or acknowledgement.
Distribution lists can directly include individual persons.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
